title: Slavoj Žižek | Why Be Happy When You Could Be Interesting? | Big Think
summary: A two-minute Big Think clip of Slavoj Zizek arguing that happiness is a conformist, even unethical goal. He asks why one would want to be happy when one could be interesting.
why: HN shares it as a short, provocative counterpoint in threads on purpose, goals and the pursuit of happiness.

quote.text: I'll leave you with this 2 minute video from Slovenian philosopher Slavoj Žižek
